name: Tree Tops
quote: She introduced me to a medication that, within just 6 months, almost completely regrew my hair.
text: I can't recommend Dr. Nicola Clayton and the London Skin and Hair Clinic highly enough. I’ve had Alopecia Areata since I was 13, and over the years, I’ve seen countless dermatologists with no lasting success. At 43, I decided to give private treatment another try after a disappointing experience with a different private dermatologist who was pushing expensive, experimental treatments. From the start, Dr. Clayton was incredibly knowledgeable and focused on a practical, research-driven approach. She introduced me to a medication that, within just 6 months, almost completely regrew my hair. She offered different medication options, making it all very affordable compared to other treatments I had been offered. Dr. Clayton also helped me with an NHS referral, which took a while, but after a 10-month wait, I finally received NHS funding for my medication. I’m absolutely over the moon with the results, and I feel so grateful to have found Dr. Clayton. Her expertise, directness, and simple, effective approach made all the difference. Without a doubt, I would recommend her to anyone seeking treatment for hair loss – I truly feel like I struck gold finding her.

name: Marriiia DeeStar
quote: Thank you for making me feel there is a way forward and to not suffer in silence. This has changed my life.
text: Thank you for making me feel there is a way forward and to not suffer in silence. This has changed my life.

name: Thao Le
quote: My skin looked as normal after 2 months and now, after 6 months, I’m so confident to show off my natural face.
text: I had an uneven color skin (kind of eczema) in 10 years and had been with #1 dermatologists in my country, Vietnam but it didn’t change. They couldn’t give me an effective treatment and I just felt hopeless when my skin became worse and worse in every summer. I got a half-hour- appointment with Dr.Anna Chapman which is about £280 (I don’t remember exactly as it has been 6 months). I thought I wouldn’t believe in dermatologist anymore if my skin wouldn’t get better as I spent so much money to visit one of the best clinic in London.. Dr Anna looked at my skin and found out the issue, gave me ointments and cream. My skin looked as normal after 2 months and now, after 6 months, I’m so confident to show off my natural face A smooth and even color skin make me feel more beautiful. Thank you Dr. Anna!

name: Truth Prevails
quote: Not only did Dr Wade go well above the scheduled amount of time for the consultation, he also managed to resolve some concerns that I had been experiencing for a number of years.
text: I visited The London Skin and Hair Clinic in July this year and met with Dr Martin Wade. He was very friendly, helpful and made time to listen to all my problems and make recommendations. He then also sent me a write-up; detailing all my problems (I took a long list to the consultation!) and what measures I can take against each one. Not only did Dr Wade go well above the scheduled amount of time for the consultation, he also managed to resolve some concerns that I had been experiencing for a number of years. One of these was a shampoo for my Psoriasis which is one of the only things to have ever made a difference, the other was a injection for a keloid scar on my back, which 2 months post-treatment is now completely flat! I have recommended this clinic to quite a number of people and would definately go back myself, without hesitation; the next time I have any skin or hair/scalp concerns.

name: Claudia Bragman
quote: She was very sensitive to the emotional impact of coping with acne in your late twenties.
text: I came to see Dr Baron after having struggled with acne for several years. During my consultation, we decided that Isotretinoin would be the best treatment option for me. Dr Baron was both professional and also approachable and friendly. She was very sensitive to the emotional impact of coping with acne in your late twenties. What I really liked was that she really took the time to explain the treatment, its side effects and how to manage them. She was very understanding and helpful when addressing my doubts regarding the treatment. I was extremely satisfied with the service and with the choice of treatment as I have lovely clear skin as a result.

name: Catherine Marks
quote: So far great results - significant reduction in the pigmentation and quality of my skin.
text: I've had a few pigmentation laser (AFT) sessions to treat melasma with Yasmina and can't speak highly enough of the service and the way Yasmina has put me at ease through the treatment which isn't the most fun! So far great results - significant reduction in the pigmentation and quality of my skin with new skincare recommendations. Yasmina is outstanding - thoroughly recommend.

name: Daniel Coelho
quote: The doctor instead recommended a much cheaper alternative! A month on and I am already seeing results!
text: A great place for honest and thorough advice. I went into the clinic to seek information for a rather expensive treatment for hair loss and the doctor instead recommended a much cheaper alternative! A month on and I am already seeing results!

name: Hannah Thornton
quote: I left feeling supported and understood but most importantly a solution!
text: I had the best experience. I went in regarding hairloss related to an acne medication I was taking and I left feeling supported and understood but most importantly a solution! A month later and my symptoms have stopped and I am so grateful. My doctor and nurse, who took my blood test, were both so kind, funny and professional.

name: Peter Symonds
quote: The concern and consideration of every single member of staff has been exceptional.
text: I have had treatment at the London Skin & Hair Clinic a number of times over the past three years, initially for successful laser treatment which was carried out by the wonderful Yasmina, and most recently PDT (Photodynamic Treatment) under the supervision of Doctor Martin Wade, who has been, throughout, wonderfully reassuring and considerate, recommending and overseeing a treatment that has been entirely successful. The administration of that treatment was carried out sensitively and compassionately by Edward Hyde, who could not have been more caring, even following up with calls the days after the procedures to ensure all was well. The concern and consideration of every single member of staff has been exceptional. I recommend The London Skin & Hair Clinic unreservedly.

name: Jahangir Ahmed
quote: I would highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a dermatologist who combines expertise with genuine compassion.
text: Had a truly wonderful experience at this clinic from start to finish. The admin team was incredibly efficient and accommodating, managing to get me booked for an urgent appointment the very next day, which really put my mind at ease. Upon meeting Professor Pierre Vabres, I immediately felt comfortable, he was friendly, professional, and approachable. He was clear and concise in his explanations, quickly arriving at a diagnosis without any unnecessary fuss. What I appreciated most was how he thoroughly discussed all the available treatment options, ensuring I understood each one before making a decision. The whole process felt seamless, and the level of care was exceptional. I would highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a dermatologist who combines expertise with genuine compassion.

name: T D
quote: I woke up at 2AM for pure worry! … but I needn’t have worried - my clinician Kylie was outstanding!
text: I must admit I was a little nervous today – I woke up at 2AM for pure worry! This was my first time of course, but I needn’t have worried - my clinician Kylie was outstanding! She carefully explained every step, helping me understand what was happening before that particular part of the treatment. She was well prepared, experienced, and very professional. One could tell that she was really invested and committed to her work. I found myself wondering why I didn’t do this earlier. Thank you so much, Kylie!!

name: Juliet Ingram
quote: She put me so much at ease and the stitches are a thing of beauty.
text: Just wanted to pass on my thanks to Dr Kim Varma for being the most personable and professional skin doc. She performed a small surgery on my arm, which I was pretty nervous about, but she put me so much at ease and the stitches are a thing of beauty. She's also really friendly and funny, she gave me a good chuckle while the procedure was happening, I was totally distracted.

name: Jas Jandu
quote: Dr Louise Fuller is a very caring and experienced paediatric dermatologist - really put our child at ease.
text: We cannot recommend the Clinic highly enough - particularly Dr Fuller Also the Admin Team are very helpful and managed to source us an appointment very quickly Dr Louise Fuller is a very caring and experienced paediatric dermatologist - really put our child at ease There was swift action, patience and a very understanding/caring approach - we would have no hesitation in recommending her services to all family/friends There is also the convenience of a pharmacy on site to avoid any delays and the costs are reasonable.

name: Alexandra Hesse
quote: An extra thank you to the receptionist for indulging my son with her in-depth Pokemon knowledge. It was the highlight of his day.
text: Thank you so much to all the staff at London Skin and Hair Clinic. You could not have been friendlier and more welcoming. I brought my five year old in and both the doctor and the receptionists put him (and me) at ease, so that he was more than happy to be examined. Dr. Crawley was extremely warm and yet thorough. I would not hesitate to go back there again. Also, an extra thank you to the receptionist for indulging my son with her in-depth Pokemon knowledge. It was the highlight of his day.

name: David Cannon
quote: Been a customer of the clinic for over 15 years. Dr. Wade really knows his stuff.
text: Highly expert, polite and friendly. Been a customer of the clinic for over 15 years. Dr. Wade really knows his stuff. Deep knowledge and he relates it in a really understandable way without being partronizing. I think the prices are fine for this level of service. I still have all my hair as I approach 75. It is such a relief getting answers to skin related things you may be worrying about. Most are not serious and can be easily managed but really worth knowing when you have something that needs serious attention well before it could gets dangerous.

name: Luke Fry
quote: He talked through my history in an understanding and calm manner … and did a full skin check.
text: After having 4 moles removed I am quite sensitive of changes and had noticed some pain in a mole on the weekend. I booked to see Dr Raichura and he was great. He talked through my history in an understanding and calm manner, he gave good advice and did a full skin check not only for that mole but of all the moles on my upper body. Fortunately, the mole is fine, however, from my experience, I would happily have booked the removal with Dr Raichura. The team on reception were very friendly and I found the whole experience easy and straightforward.

name: Merymelek
quote: Her calm and caring approach made the experience smooth and stress-free.
text: I had a skin tag removal treatment at this clinic under the care of Dr Inna, and I’m very pleased with the experience. Dr Inna was gentle, reassuring, and extremely clear in explaining every step of the procedure, which immediately put me at ease. The treatment itself was even better than I expected. It was carried out with great professionalism, and I felt well looked after throughout the entire process. Dr Inna made sure I was comfortable at every stage, and her calm and caring approach made the experience smooth and stress-free. I’m very happy with the results and would highly recommend this clinic to anyone considering treatment.

name: Natacha McManus
quote: Even though it was a virtual appointment, it felt very personal and attentive.
text: I had an excellent experience with my video consultation. Kate was incredibly professional, knowledgeable, and took the time to thoroughly understand my concerns and goals. Everything was explained clearly, including the procedure options, expected results, and aftercare, which made me feel confident and well-informed. Even though it was a virtual appointment, it felt very personal and attentive. I never felt rushed, and all my questions were answered in detail. I really appreciated the honest advice and tailored recommendations. Highly recommend this service to anyone considering a facial procedure, a convenient, reassuring, and genuinely helpful experience from start to finish.

name: Jordan Bertulis
quote: Thank you for making a daunting experience for me a good one!!
text: Had a blood test appointment today. Normally I am very nervous and I’m not very good around needles but Chandni made me feel completely at ease and the test itself was painless! Thank you for making a daunting experience for me a good one!!

name: Izzy Karran
quote: I couldn’t wish for a better dermatologist or experience.
text: Dr Wade is amazing, he is compassionate, informative and endlessly patient, tolerating my million questions graciously. I couldn’t wish for a better dermatologist or experience. Everyone who works at the clinic is lovely, and they are also easy to contact and very responsive. I highly recommended.
